turns.response_html: The word "Estes" is not a common French word, but it is a surname that can have several meanings. In French, it is most often related to land ownership or estate. The similar word "Este" (without the "s") is an adjective meaning Estonian.

The word you are likely looking for is "astuce" (pronounced ahs-toos), which is a common French word.

It is a feminine noun that means:

  • A trick, tip, or clever solution. This is the most common meaning in everyday language. For example, "J'ai une astuce pour résoudre ce problème" means "I have a tip to solve this problem."
  • Shrewdness or astuteness. This refers to a person's cleverness or sagacity.
  • A gimmick or clever maneuver. This can have a slightly negative connotation, implying something that is a bit of a trick or deception.
